t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Hi! All gnomes have different colours that will lead you to different areas. for example, blue, red, orange and pink will lead you to a dark forest, while all other colours lead you to a bright one. The baskets in these forests will also be different colours, and the gnomes in question are all in specific pairs. I suggest writing down which gnomes appear with each other and what forest each colour leads to. The pose or size of the gnome does not matter, only the colours.As well as keeping track of the gnome colours and pairs, tracking what amount specifically coloured baskets give you depending on what forest you are in is important too. The aim of the game is to gain as many mushrooms as possible, and this info is crucial to obtain a high score.Forgive me if this makes little sense, or if some of the info (such as the colours of the gnomes) are incorrect. It was hard to remember most of it. Have fun :)

vb_textbox.text: Hi there! Firstly, the gnomes will all appear in fixed pairs. These include Orange and brown, Pink and green, red and yellow and blue and purple. The positions of the gnomes may switch but the colours will always be paired together. Secondly, in these pairs, one will lead you to a bright forest, while the other will bring you to a autumn themed forest. Orange, green, blue and red will bring you to the bright forestBrown, pink, yellow and purple will bring you to the autumn forest.You will have to try to memorize which colour gnome brings you to the bright or autumn forest, and you will have to use that info to gain as many mushrooms as possible.Here is an example of this stategy: The green and pink gnomes appear, and you click the pink one. The pink one brings you to the autumn forest with a high amount of mushrooms, so you keep that in mind. The next time pink and green appear, you may choose green and see it has less mushrooms, so from that point on, you choose pink every time the two show up. (This is only an example! I do not know whether pink or green has a higher amount for sure, you will have to figure it out yourself!)I apologize if this doesn't make sense, or if it is too long. Have fun! :)(P.S, apart from the colour, the appearance of the gnomes do not have any impact! Don't worry about it, and just focus on the colour!)
